decisive_items: spindle cells had bipolar cytoplasmic extensions and round-to-oval nuclei with fine granular chromatin
all lesions were confined to the subcutaneous tissue
response.rationale: Multiple subcutaneous, mobile nodules in cervical, paraspinal, and abdominal locations with benign spindle cells showing bipolar cytoplasmic extensions and collagenous matrix are most consistent with neurofibroma. Fibromatosis is typically solitary and deeper, while dermatofibroma is usually dermal and solitary with overlying skin changes.

rejected.why: Dermatofibroma is typically a solitary dermal lesion with epidermal changes; these lesions are multiple, subcutaneous, mobile, and lack overlying skin changes.
Fibromatosis usually presents as a solitary deep infiltrative fibrous mass, not multiple mobile subcutaneous nodules, and the cytology here favors a neural origin.
